title: The Alarm Spreads Upward
mission: Record every room's height, then the vault's diameter
briefing: The alarm does not start at the entrance. It starts at the dead ends and climbs. A dead end has height 1. Any other room is one floor taller than its taller side. You cannot answer for a room until both rooms below it are answered, which is exactly the order a postorder walk computes heights in. When every floor is mapped, report the diameter - the most rooms on any single path through the vault.
hints: Leaf height is 1, not 0. An empty corridor is 0, so a leaf is 1 + max(0, 0).
A room with one child of height 3 and one of height 1 has height 4 - the TALLER child plus one.
The diameter path bends at one room: left height + right height + 1. Check that sum at every room, not just the entrance.
